name: @corvus/marketing
description: Corvus Marketing Site built with Astro

scripts.copy-install: bash -c 'if [ -f ../../../../scripts/install.sh ]; then cp ../../../../scripts/install.sh public/install; else echo "scripts/install.sh not found; skipping copy"; fi'
scripts.format: biome format --write src public package.json astro.config.mjs tsconfig.json README.md
scripts.check: biome check src public package.json astro.config.mjs tsconfig.json README.md
